description: participación individual del desafío abandonados, pero no olvidados.
summary: In short, the project wants to share information about the ships that have been forgotten and whose history we don't know. The goal is to make the history of these ships known and to understand how their discoveries have helped space science, with the rovers on Mars and different missions abandoned on the Moon. These ships help us get to know our neighborhood and our companions, the planets, and they have helped us figure out if we can send human life beyond our sky.
details: The project is not a game but a video edited so that you can get to know the stories of ships from Mars and the moon, where things gradually happen and you can read little by little and learn information about these abandoned ships in an appealing visual way.
dataRefs: Data with dates and information about the probes left on Mars and the Moon
